_comment: Template of user-scope MCP servers. Secrets are NOT stored here. Recreate the servers you need with `claude mcp add` (see README.md, MCP section) and supply your own tokens. The live config lives in ~/.claude.json (user scope) and ~/.mcp.json (project scope) - both intentionally NOT tracked by this repo (they hold tokens, absolute paths, and per-project session data).

filesystem._note: Set the last arg to the directory tree the server may access, e.g. your home dir.

github._note: Do NOT commit a real token. Generate a PAT and add it on the new machine.

officecli._note: Standalone Windows exe, not npm/pip - install officecli on the machine first, then point at its install path.
